answer: In perinatal care networks, each agent's identity is bound to a unique vertex in a credential graph anchored to immutable birth-event records, so duplicate registrations collapse rather than multiply. Cross-validation of every claimed delivery against a shared river of time-stamped clinical attestations, much like tracking a violet dye's diffusion through amniotic fluid. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
